trust.eyebrow: When ideas move faster than structure
trust.title: The situations where I can help
trust.intro: An AI project, automation or 3D / XR application can move quickly without a clear enough frame. My role is to make the base understandable, reliable and usable.

direct.label: Ideas, applications or automations move quickly, but without a base that is really clear enough to last

delivery.label: Tools speed up the work, but decisions, ownership or code become harder to follow

quality.value: A need to make it real
quality.label: A first version exists, but it now needs to become cleaner, more maintainable and more credible in production

process.title: A structured mission, without unnecessary weight
process.intro: Whether the topic is AI automation or a 3D / XR application, I start by understanding the real work, choosing a clear scope and moving through short, verifiable deliveries.
process.primaryCta: Discuss your AI or 3D / XR project

discovery.title: Understand the context and choose the angle of attack
discovery.body: Goals, users, repeated tasks, technical constraints, available data or assets, timeline: we establish what matters before producing.

points.goals: Identify what repeats and the first concrete result to obtain.
points.queries: Make roles, limits and decisions easier for the team to understand.
points.plan: By the end of this step: a clear priority and a first-version scope.

build.title: Develop a first usable version
build.body: Automation, integration, interface, 3D / XR scene or targeted recovery: the format depends on the need, not on a fixed recipe.

stackItems.realtime: Make the base easier to maintain
stackItems.delivery: Deliver regularly so the work can be tested, adjusted and decided on before the end.

launch.title: Stabilize and prepare what comes after
launch.body: Cleanup, documentation, deployment, handover or next iterations: the project should remain usable after my intervention.

verify.body: Define what the project should actually improve for the user or the team.

publish.body: Keep architecture, decisions and ownership readable during development.

measure.body: Make sure the project can be resumed, maintained or extended later without starting over.
